prompts.fortressWall: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless game environment wall-face texture, one square material filling the image, for a hand-painted semi-realistic dark fantasy shinobi military stronghold. Weathered massive dressed blue-gray basalt masonry, long offset stone courses, thick worn bevels, chisel marks, hairline cracks, subtle black moss in joints, occasional old bronze fastener. Seen squarely from the front with a very slight top-down angle, flat orthographic lighting. Muted slate and charcoal colors, carefully painted contact shadows in grout, subtle warm stone edges, readable mid-dark values. No floor, ground, entire room, free-standing objects, flames, glyph text, labels, logos, UI, borders. Seamlessly repeatable in both directions. Texture completely fills every edge, with consistent stone scale. Art must feel like a fortified constructed base, not natural terrain.
prompts.caveWall: Use case: stylized-concept. prompts.fortressFixtures: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production prop sprite atlas for a dark fantasy shinobi fortified underground military base. Transparent background. Exact 3 by 3 layout of nine distinct isolated objects, evenly spaced in equal square cells with generous empty transparent margins. Same orthographic top-down three-quarter camera for every prop, viewed from high above, no horizon. Semi-realistic hand-painted game artwork, tactile dark timber, worn charcoal masonry, aged bronze fittings and subdued oxblood banners. Crisp detailed silhouettes, no cast shadow outside each prop, consistent scale. Row 1 left to right: a heavy square stone pillar with a dark red vertical military banner; an iron brazier with warm orange flame; a sturdy rack holding shinobi spears and swords. Row 2: three iron-bound wooden military supply crates; a dark wooden cabinet holding scroll bundles and sealed documents; a sturdy narrow barracks bunk with muted dark bedding. Row 3: a squat fortified double iron-bound gate set into a compact carved stone doorway; a low military war table with a parchment map and restrained tiny tactical pieces; an ancient armored guardian statue on a square stone plinth. Each object fits entirely within its own cell, no touching, no overlapping, no ground tiles, no backdrop, no drawn grid, no text, labels, numbers, logo or border. These are architecture and functional base furnishings, not terrain texture.
